column1: # Curated kids / education channels for TV Hub (iptv-org channel ids).
# tier: core = free-to-air, public broadcaster or official FAST channel -> kids-en.m3u
#       grey = pay-TV channel restreamed by a third party, licensing unclear -> kids-en-grey.m3u
# Anything not listed here is reported as a candidate and never written to a playlist.
# Family time: documentaries watched together with a parent.
# CCTV is the Chinese state broadcaster. CCTV-14 is its children's channel.
# Live recitation from Masjid al-Haram (not 24/7), with Masjid an-Nabawi as the fallback.
# Da Vinci Asia: the STEM channel we want, but its only stream is a proxy that redirects to a
# session-token'd Viettel TV360 address in Vietnam. Two of three probes timed out, so it would
# be a channel that often refuses to open. The licensed route in Indonesia is Vidio.
